text.tspan: Aurora: one shared, self-healing storage volume across 3 AZs
Shared storage volume: auto-expands in 10 GB steps, up to 256 TB
• 6 copies in 3 AZs: 4 of 6 needed to write,
• replica lag in milliseconds; failover < 30 s
• costs ~20% more than RDS, but more efficient
• custom endpoints: a subset of replicas
• Replica auto scaling: add replicas on load
• Serverless: capacity scales with use, pay per
• Global Database: 1 primary + up to 10 read-only
regions, lag < 1 s, promote (DR) RTO < 1 min
• Aurora ML: call SageMaker / Comprehend in SQL
